title: In Georgia, niche fragrances appeal to consumers seeking exclusivity
summary: In Georgia, as elsewhere, the niche fragrance market is growing rapidly. Rising demand is driving the opening of new, highly selective boutiques, alongside the emergence of local brands that remain relatively under the radar. Meanwhile, the trade in dupes and counterfeit fragrances is also benefiting from this broader enthusiasm. A closer look at the market in Tbilisi. The development of niche perfumery in Georgia, a segment that remains out of reach for most consumers, is closely linked... - Markets & trends / Europe
